result.title: Practice in Text, Act in Pixels: Correcting Where Perception Fails
result.comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 19 tables. Code: https://github.com/Carlxuzhl/practice-in-text ; aligned reader: https://huggingface.co/xuzhl/practice-in-text-aligned-reader
result.summary: GUI agents can learn cheaply from a text view of an interface and act on screenshots through a vision-language screen reader. Yet on a simulated mobile platform with a low-cost reader, policies that complete most tasks in text fail on many of the same tasks on screenshots. We ask where a small budget of real screenshots is best spent to close this gap. We find that the reader's misreads are systematic and recur on the same interface elements. Noise matched to the reader's error rates, a natural sim-to-real remedy, misses this structure, and in a pre-specified comparison it did not beat training the policy directly on screenshots. We therefore correct the misreads at their source with reader alignment, which fine-tunes the reader on screenshots paired with their text views. The reader learns to output each screen's text view, as in text practice, and the policy stays unchanged. Spent on the reader, the screenshot budget gives 80.9% full-task success on new task instances, against 55.6% when spent on training the policy. Given the same labeled screenshots, adapting the reader also beats adapting the policy, and a single aligned reader improves every text-trained policy we tried without retraining any of them.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 GUI agent 从文本界面练习迁移到截图执行时的感知失败：发现屏幕阅读器的误读集中出现在相同界面元素上，于是用少量真实截图微调阅读器，使其输出对应文本视图，而策略保持不变。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作把文本—截图差距定位为视觉感知环节的系统性错误，并比较截图预算用于阅读器对齐还是策略训练；可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、感知瓶颈和训练监督分配，但不涉及显式 latent 推理状态。
